actual_work: Isolated worker change in the completed initial 144 paired-job factor matrix; 24 earlier full Playground games (8 seeds × auto32/explicit4/affinity-auto6), plus separate fresh 16 Playground and 8 Oazis participant-count games.
code: Affinity-aware auto participant discovery implemented and retained; explicit counts preserved.
outcome: Largest underreported accepted fix: auto32→auto6 within six eligible logical CPUs reduced whole-process CPU 46.98%, wall34.25%, RSS14.32% in ten-layout initial matrix. Fixed-three negative control essentially flat. Earlier eight-seed full Playground affinity-auto6 CPU29.81% and whole elapsed18.16% lower.
decision: Accepted general eligible-CPU ceiling; no global optimum3, no unrestricted-host speed promise.
reopen_criteria: Reopen for affinity/quota correctness on additional operating systems or coordinator allocations, not a universal three-thread optimum. Compare speed and throughput under the same total budget.

actual_work: 48 native timed windows/24 pairs at N4/N6/auto32 plus16 windows/8 pairs at N3; twelve separate full8192-tick control traces. Later ten-layout preferred-participant factor and mature factor controls.

actual_work: Actual first-quarantine event observer, device/pacing controls;14 paired timing jobs for host synchronization,39 recovery-vs-sync jobs; actual hardware cancellation/reap/fresh-field and scalar material/clear/guard oracle cases.
code: Required host synchronization retained; recovery prototype implemented, exercised on real GPU and rejected.
outcome: Startup GPU contexts cost roughly114–116MiB while useful completion low; recovery increased committed GPU fields but added CPU and wall cost across varied workloads.
decision: Keep synchronization correctness and permanent-failure safe CPU fallback; reject recovery as optimization.
reopen_criteria: Do not adopt retry recovery merely to increase participation. Reopen around useful batch size, transfer volume and publication deadlines, measuring total CPU/wall/RSS and useful commits.
